title: What’s your astra workflow?
author: maltmaker
selftext:
I see all these coop games but I need help understanding your workflowa and tools! 

  
do you just open up codex and say make a game no mistakes? 

  
do you open unreal and connect the mcp server and do everything in the terminal? please help! I’d love to make a game but I try setting it up and Astra doesn’t do anything before running out of tokens just setting up the environment.

comments.author: Jaded_Software_
comments.body:
I’ve spent the past year building a custom game engine that removes the need for a pipeline flow.

I edit my model, it immediately takes effect in my game engine. I change an animation, it immediately takes effect.

Because the LLM just has to use the engines MCP, token usage is reduced.

I’m about a month away from being ready for beta testers

[https://jadedsoftware.com](https://jadedsoftware.com)

comments.author: Snoo-29395
comments.body:
\- I think of a feature i want to add

\- I go back and forward with astra, research how what i want to do is usually made, etc

\- Translate the plan into a milestone with subtickest, as small and descriptive as possible

\- Tackle the tickets one by one until the work is done

\- Move to the next feature and repeat

replies.author: maltmaker
replies.body: What tools are you using? just the web version? are you developing in plain code or in unreal?

replies.author: Snoo-29395
replies.body:
Oh boy, now i understand the question. Web version is a no go for years now, download the app, and search some tutorials on how to work with the apps, you will understand then how the things posted here are possible.

That being said, be always suspicious about people bragging about one prompting something amazing, is rather a lie or is just a scripted thing that won't work other than as a X post

replies.author: maltmaker
replies.body: Ya that’s what I’m kinda curious about, right now I’m trying to build something in unreal using the mcp server but Astra loves tokens. I think they must have fixed something though because I’m able to get a bit more out of it now than before.
